status: Ready for owner review, not production approval
scope: Bounded Bloodridge scenery refinement around a genuine, frozen KS battle capture. No Unity integration, gameplay implementation or renderer change.
review_rule: Audit each pass at native scale, in the complete battle screen, and with an independent pixel critic before presenting it. Correct blocking findings first; keep limitations visible. Jacob's approval remains separate.

passes.initial: BLOCKED: smaller paving and stronger tomb landmark improved location, but excessive floor speckling competed with thin fighter silhouettes.
passes.corrections: Rejected the initial texture, a blotchy palette/filter treatment, a flat polygon treatment and a noisy PixelLab material candidate. Retained connected-cluster cleanup and lower-contrast ground, without resampling the scenery.
passes.independent_review: Combat-readability blocker removed at supplied full-screen scale. Remaining cloudy/mottled clusters are still a craft limitation.

passes.pass: 2 - contact, near framing and asset separation
passes.changes: Pose-specific foot and hem contacts; larger near stone/root silhouettes visible above HUD; removable bronze/stone marker and linen; complete opaque floor under the near props; separate rear architecture and rooted entrance.
passes.independent_review: No new blocking seam or readability regression. Better ground contact, intentional edge crops and continuous visible floor. Shadow direction remains subtle rather than a rigorously demonstrated lighting solution.

passes.changes: Free PixelLab ash and dust behind combat plus anchored, whole-pixel linen motion; 32 frames at 125 ms.
passes.independent_review: No blocking occlusion, seam or readability regression in inspected frames. Linen lower silhouette moves without obvious gaps; internal folds do not yet respond to tension. Dust is very subtle. Static inspection does not prove smooth playback.

mechanical_checks.aseprite_validation: layers, export_readiness and animation passed. Constant timing note is intentional for environmental motion. Full palette/antialias scan timed out at 120 seconds and is not claimed as passed. A lint score is not an art-quality rating.
mechanical_checks.loop_boundary: 481 changed composite pixels from 32 to 1 versus 1001 maximum between other neighbours; no exceptional boundary jump by this measure. Counts alone do not prove expressive or smooth motion.

browser_review.motion_limit: Browser playback progression and wrap verified with UI state and sampled images. This does not establish real-time combat readability or subjective smoothness for the owner.

remaining_limits: Some arbitrary mottled floor and wall clusters remain; the environment is not yet consistently crafted to the fighters' level.
The Bloodridge burial landmark, roots, cloth and bronze improve regional identity; oppression/eeriness remains subject to Jacob's review.
Linen moves gently but its internal folds remain largely unchanged; atmospheric dust is deliberately very restrained.
The rear architecture is a fixed-camera partition. Newly painted hidden facades and free parallax are not established.
Near props and floor underpaint are separate useful review assets, not a complete seamless/autotile kit or 3D mesh set. The experimental terrain-pieces.png and stone-*.png are rejected.
Captured combat predates Sprint 1 and is held still. Full-fight readability, moving-unit contact, attacks behind props, current game rules and Unity performance are not verified.
